_meta.role: New Grad - Software Engineer ML Ops

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with experience building and deploying ML systems for robotics and edge computing. Optimized TensorRT YOLO pipelines on Jetson hardware, built ONNX export and evaluation workflows, and developed dataset curation pipelines for computer vision training.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile edge deployment.
Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset, building the end-to-end labeling-to-training pipeline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by rebuilding preprocessing and fine-tuning DONUT (VisionEncoderDecoder) on a custom medical billing dataset.
Built end-to-end PyTorch training pipelines with HuggingFace Transformers; added domain-specific tokens and resized decoder embeddings.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF sensor data into HID commands via Python.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency; deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on Jetson across a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson+Arduino).
Built a LeRobot-structured multi-camera data collection pipeline using multiprocessing; resolved 11 integration failures across detection, servo, and depth sensing subsystems.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated with 30 vehicles — zero collisions across multiple laps.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time tracking; relayed commands to STM32 over UART with FreeRTOS mutex-protected shared memory and VL53L0X ToF distance sensing.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B with <1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; profiled VRAM and latency using pynvml.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
